scope: Compare profile source SHA to independently published latest gate detail SHA, not proof of missing archived source
interpretation: Visible biography files were SHA-bound to older match-details snapshots than the last gate detail snapshots. Both are pre-match research only. No same-fixture source equivalence claimed; exact SHA archival source required before reusing biographies.

remediation.allowed: Use exact-byte original current source or a restricted archived detail with SHA-256 equal to the biography's declared source.
remediation.fail_closed: If exact source is unavailable, throw PROFILE_AUDIT_ORIGINAL_DETAIL_SHA_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE; never silently match latest LAST.
